title: Album release: Ringo Starr And His Third All-Starr Band – Volume 1 by Ringo Starr | 1997
content:
Ringo Starr And His Third All-Starr Band – Volume 1, the third live album by Ringo Starr, was released on 12 August 1997.

It was recorded by the former Beatles drummer and the All-Starr Band at the Nippon Budokan Hall in Tokyo, Japan, on 27 June 1995.

The album was a limited edition of 10,000 available only from Blockbuster video stores in North America for $5.99. Due to its restricted availability it did not chart.

Three of the album’s recordings later appeared on the 2001 box set The Anthology… So Far: ‘Boris The Spider’, ‘People Got To Be Free’, and ‘You Ain’t Seen Nothing Yet’.
